SELECT TOP(2) [t].[TicketId], [t].[ActualDuration], [t].[AffectsCustomer], [t].[AssignedDate], [t].[AssignedTo], [t].[Category], [t].[CreatedBy], [t].[CreatedDate], [t].[CurrentStatusDate], [t].[CurrentStatusSetBy], [t].[Details], [t].[DueDate], [t].[EstimatedDuration], [t].[IsHtml], [t].[LastUpdateBy], [t].[LastUpdateDate], [t].[Owner], [t].[Priority], [t].[ProjectId], [t].[ResolutionDate], [t].[TagList], [t].[TargetDate], [t].[TicketStatus], [t].[TicketType], [t].[Title], [t].[Version], [p].[ProjectId], [p].[ProjectDescription], [p].[ProjectName], [p].[Version]
FROM [dbo].[Tickets] AS [t]
INNER JOIN [dbo].[Projects] AS [p] ON [t].[ProjectId] = [p].[ProjectId]
WHERE [t].[TicketId] = @ticketId
ORDER BY [t].[TicketId], [p].[ProjectId]

SELECT [t0].[TicketId], [t0].[EventId], [t0].[Comment], [t0].[EventBy], [t0].[EventDate], [t0].[EventDescription], [t0].[ForActivity], [t0].[IsHtml], [t0].[Version], [s].[TicketId], [s].[ProjectId]
FROM (
    SELECT TOP(1) [t].[TicketId], [p].[ProjectId]
    FROM [dbo].[Tickets] AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[Projects] AS [p] ON [t].[ProjectId] = [p].[ProjectId]
    WHERE [t].[TicketId] = @ticketId
    ORDER BY [t].[TicketId], [p].[ProjectId]
) AS [s]
INNER JOIN [dbo].[TicketEvents] AS [t0] ON [s].[TicketId] = [t0].[TicketId]
ORDER BY [s].[TicketId], [s].[ProjectId]

SELECT [t1].[TicketTagId], [t1].[TagName], [t1].[TicketId], [s0].[TicketId], [s0].[ProjectId]
FROM (
    SELECT TOP(1) [t].[TicketId], [p].[ProjectId]
    FROM [dbo].[Tickets] AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[Projects] AS [p] ON [t].[ProjectId] = [p].[ProjectId]
    WHERE [t].[TicketId] = @ticketId
    ORDER BY [t].[TicketId], [p].[ProjectId]
) AS [s0]
INNER JOIN [dbo].[TicketTags] AS [t1] ON [s0].[TicketId] = [t1].[TicketId]
ORDER BY [s0].[TicketId], [s0].[ProjectId]

SELECT [t2].[TicketId], [t2].[SubscriberId], [s1].[TicketId], [s1].[ProjectId]
FROM (
    SELECT TOP(1) [t].[TicketId], [p].[ProjectId]
    FROM [dbo].[Tickets] AS [t]
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[Projects] AS [p] ON [t].[ProjectId] = [p].[ProjectId]
    WHERE [t].[TicketId] = @ticketId
    ORDER BY [t].[TicketId], [p].[ProjectId]
) AS [s1]
INNER JOIN [dbo].[TicketSubscribers] AS [t2] ON [s1].[TicketId] = [t2].[TicketId]
ORDER BY [s1].[TicketId], [s1].[ProjectId]
